input: Update emergency contact info at my workplace

gold.taskTitle: Update Emergency Contact Info at Workplace
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to update their emergency contact information on file with their employer.

questions.title: Who is the new emergency contact person?
questions.description: Identify the specific person the user wants to designate as their emergency contact.

questions.title: What contact details need to be updated or added?
questions.description: Determine which details are being updated, such as phone number, address, or relationship.

questions.title: Is this a replacement or an additional contact?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user is replacing an existing emergency contact or adding a new one alongside existing records.

questions.title: Which department or system handles this at your workplace?
questions.description: Find out whether this goes through HR, an internal portal, a manager, or another channel.

questions.title: Do you have login access to your HR or employee portal?
questions.description: Determine whether the user can self-serve online or needs to go through a person or paper process.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which this must be done?
questions.description: Understand if there is any urgency, such as an upcoming compliance review, life event, or personal reason.

questions.title: Has your emergency contact person agreed and given their details?
questions.description: Confirm whether the user has already gathered the necessary information from the contact person.
